trigger.decision: old canary function instrument remains failed; threshold and five disagreements are not rewritten
trigger.construct_problem: reviewers sometimes used unrelated response risk or overall acceptability to cancel an otherwise realized component function

orthogonal_definition.function: whether the authorized candidate makes a literal contribution to the final response and realizes the component-specific response act while respecting the candidate's own owner, time, and use boundary
orthogonal_definition.risk: unsupported facts, wrong identity, excessive directiveness, or other harmful extra content anywhere in the response; recorded independently and never used to erase a realized function
orthogonal_definition.quality: positive support contribution; recorded independently and never inferred from function
orthogonal_definition.cost: injected and provider resource telemetry; recorded independently
orthogonal_definition.causal_limit: ON-only function is mechanism evidence, not proof that the candidate caused quality uplift; causal value comes only from randomized same-state ON-minus-OFF outcomes

atomic_reviewer_fields.candidate_contribution_present: YES only with exact candidate-span and response-span IDs showing more than a topical word echo
atomic_reviewer_fields.required_response_act_realized: YES only when the component-specific minimum act is visible in the final response
atomic_reviewer_fields.candidate_owner_time_use_boundary_respec: YES unless the candidate contribution itself has wrong owner/time/version or violates its frozen when-not-to-use condition
atomic_reviewer_fields.unrelated_response_risk: not visible to the function reviewer and not part of the function projection
atomic_reviewer_fields.projection: FUNCTIONAL iff all three atomic fields are YES; any NO is NONFUNCTIONAL; any UNRESOLVED yields UNRESOLVED

component_minimums.MP: the verified profile, preference, relationship, or stable fact materially personalizes or constrains the response; name/topic echo alone is insufficient
component_minimums.MS: a specific strictly-prior observation is explicitly and accurately bridged to the present exchange while preserving its past or uncertain status
component_minimums.ME: a past action-result or event materially changes how a present option, warning, or suggestion is framed; it must not promise recurrence
component_minimums.RS: the selected card's one atomic support move is realized, the current use condition holds, and no card-specific forbidden competing move or reopen-after-stop occurs

fresh_confirmation.source: 16 states selected outcome-blind from the remaining 88 frozen development states
fresh_confirmation.balance: 4 per component, distinct families and source clusters where feasible, interleaved execution order
fresh_confirmation.generator: three frozen paired seeds, ON and OFF, for 96 calls; raw provider reply persists before guard
fresh_confirmation.stage_1: run only 32 function calls: two reviewers x 16 ON-response groups
fresh_confirmation.stage_2: only if function measurement passes, run absolute Quality and absolute Risk for the same frozen responses
fresh_confirmation.forbidden: selecting states, changing prompts, or deleting responses using observed Q/R/F direction

fresh_function_measurement_gate.component_breakdown: reported with n=12 per component and no component result hidden by the overall value
fresh_function_measurement_gate.failure: stop before Quality/Risk calls and before the remaining 72 states; do not lower thresholds or majority-vote

development_margin.not_zero: uplift > 0 is not automatically worth opening
development_margin.freeze_once: after the 16-state fresh wave, use development baseline variability and operational relevance to freeze the meaningful-benefit/equivalence margin once
development_margin.sealed_rule: never revise the margin after held-out policy results are visible

final_pm_pass: unchanged: held-out 16-action policy performance against the predeclared baseline matrix on separate Q/R/F/C outcomes
